name: How long does it take to paint an attached two-car garage?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to paint an attached two-car garage?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard two-car garage painting project typically takes two to four days to complete. The exact timeline depends on the condition of the drywall and whether you are coating the walls, ceiling, or concrete floor. At HH Remodeling LLC, we often perform tape-and-bedding, drywall patching, or texture repairs before applying paint. Fresh mud and primer require proper drying time between coats. If you are having your garage floor coated as well, concrete prep and cure times will add another day or two before you can park vehicles inside.
acceptedAnswer.description: Painting a two-car garage usually takes two to four days, depending on wall repairs, drywall patching, and whether ceilings or floors are included.
